records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom is the approved captain's nameplate. His spoken given name and surname keep their original substitutions.
Janus Pasar is the crewmate reacting to the shipwright's lesson. Keep his turns separate from Manuel's and Cesare's.
Julio Erneco recognizes Mikhail and protects Cristina. He explicitly calls her his granddaughter in speech.
Cristina Erneco gives her approved first name and objects when Mikhail calls after her. The caption stays independent of her grandfather's address.
Cesare Tony is the trained sailor who can react to the optional lesson. The existing caption identifies the speaker without adding another shipboard role.
Gerhard Adernkatz advises Hodram about the Proofs and tests Yifa. Preserve his own role, as distinct from the person he addresses as Admiral.
Manuel Almeida answers the shipwright's question about masts. His turn is part of the already qualified lesson.
Sera Shahrbaraz remains the caption on her route through Mikhail's recruitment. Her name in speech belongs to Hodram's explanation and Mikhail's calls.
Yifa Sol gives only Yifa when she signs on. Sanghyeon's account explains their closeness without changing her own name.
Julian Lopes promises Mihwa the Silla Gold Crown and later credits Hodram. Preserve the established name she uses in reply.
Mikhail Letzel is the short caption. The native catalogue carries a separate middle field, and the notice identifies his function as scholar.
Sanghyeon Kan remains the established nameplate. He introduces himself by his given name and identifies his seniority under their shared master.
Shopkeeper identifies the source square merchant who tells Hodram about Mikhail. This dialogue supplies no personal name.
Shipwright is the source shop role. Giving the optional lesson does not make him an officer.
Sailor identifies the anonymous voice answering the pirate's order. The scene supplies no individual rank or name.
Woman is the shared caption for the onlooker who admires Mikhail and then rebukes him. Her familiar address establishes no kinship.
Lady identifies the other onlooker. Her questions about the peppercorn are distinct from the first woman's reactions.
Owner follows the clean role label for the woman who orders more bananas. Her confidence belongs to her forecast.
Cook follows the source occupation for the man carrying out the order. His replies remain skeptical despite his compliance.
Angel is the established name the pirate uses when he interrupts. Leave his standing aboard implicit.
Mihwa is the approved short nameplate in the crown exchange and the name Julian uses when addressing her.
Reika is the established short nameplate for the tavern worker in Seoul. Her description of Julian supplies the link to his visit.
